t: Honório Hermeto Carneiro Leão, Marquis of Paraná, became the de facto first prime minister of the Empire of Brazil.
Royal Navy captain Lord George Paulet began a five-month occupation of the Hawaiian Islands.
During a period of activity known as the Great Eruption, Eta Carinae briefly became the second-brightest star in the night sky.
SS Great Britain, the first ocean-going ship with both an iron hull and a screw propeller, was launched in Bristol, England.
The state wedding of Teresa Cristina of the Two Sicilies and Emperor Pedro II of Brazil took place at the Cathedral of Rio de Janeiro.
A Christmas Carol, a novella by Charles Dickens about the miser Ebenezer Scrooge and his transformation after being visited by ghosts, was published.
